thrash_about.name: Thrash About
thrash_about.description: Used only when no other move has PP left. Hurts the user.

shove.name: Shove
shove.description: A solid shove with the whole body.

quick_dart.name: Quick Dart
quick_dart.description: Darts in before the foe can react. Usually goes first.

headlong.name: Headlong
headlong.description: A reckless full-body charge. May paralyse.

bristle.name: Bristle
bristle.description: Bristles menacingly, lowering the foe's Attack.

flare_lash.name: Flare Lash
flare_lash.description: Whips the foe with a burning tail. May burn.

splash_jet.name: Splash Jet
splash_jet.description: Fires a narrow jet of water.

riptide_strike.name: Riptide Strike
riptide_strike.description: Strikes with the force of a pulling current.

leaf_cut.name: Leaf Cut
leaf_cut.description: Slices with a sharp leaf. Lands critical hits more easily.

sap_draw.name: Sap Draw
sap_draw.description: Draws out the foe's energy, restoring half the damage dealt.

wing_buffet.name: Wing Buffet
wing_buffet.description: Batters the foe with beating wings.

silk_bind.name: Silk Bind
silk_bind.description: Wraps the foe in sticky silk, sharply lowering Speed.

venom_prick.name: Venom Prick
venom_prick.description: Pricks with a venomous barb. May poison.

static_snap.name: Static Snap
static_snap.description: A sharp snap of static. May paralyse.

mud_fling.name: Mud Fling
mud_fling.description: Flings mud in the foe's eyes, lowering accuracy.

pebble_toss.name: Pebble Toss
pebble_toss.description: Hurls a handful of hard pebbles.

spore_puff.name: Spore Puff
spore_puff.description: Releases a puff of drowsy spores that put the foe to sleep.

stone_slam.name: Stone Slam
stone_slam.description: Slams into the foe with a body as hard as bedrock.

tremor_stomp.name: Tremor Stomp
tremor_stomp.description: A stomp that shakes the ground. May lower the foe's Speed.

bramble_lash.name: Bramble Lash
bramble_lash.description: Lashes the foe with thorny vines.

rootquake.name: Rootquake
rootquake.description: Heaves the ground with massive roots. May lower the foe's Speed.

forge_flare.name: Forge Flare
forge_flare.description: A blast of forge-hot flame. May burn.

iron_pounce.name: Iron Pounce
iron_pounce.description: Pounces with claws hard as tempered steel.

riptide_surge.name: Riptide Surge
riptide_surge.description: Engulfs the foe in a surging current.

reef_crush.name: Reef Crush
reef_crush.description: Rams the foe with a shell of jagged coral. May lower the foe's Defence.
